interface.shortDescription: OpenSpec execution discipline for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Keel packages reusable OpenSpec authoring and execution skills: expectation alignment before specs and tasks finalize, task-capsule discipline, deterministic gate usage, review, debugging, and handoff hygiene. The separately installed keel CLI owns context, gates, schema, and overlays.
